page_title: LEC 0-2 ROM | Lecce v AS Roma 06/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Flag up against Nikola Stulic (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
89' Manu Kone (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Artem Dovbyk is substituted due to injury. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Alessandro Romano (AS Roma).
86' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
86' Juan Luca Sacchi has issued a yellow card to Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce).
85' Rough tackle by Manu Kone (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
82' Dangerous play by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
80' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
79' Here is a change. Paulo Dybala is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Matias Soule (AS Roma).
75' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Kaba is replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
74' Konan Ndri (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' 0 - 2 Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) deflects his teammate's shot and the ball goes past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net!
70' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
70' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
69' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
68' Konan Ndri (Lecce) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

66' Mile Svilar makes a brilliant save! Konan Ndri (Lecce) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
66' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Juan Luca Sacchi signals a set piece.
64' Fabrizio Del Rosso has decided to make a change. Olaf Gorter (Lecce) replaces Ylber Ramadani.
64' Substitution. Francesco Camarda is replaced by Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
63' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) will replace Stephan El Shaarawy.
60' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Evan Ferguson and he is replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
59' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
57' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) replaces Riccardo Sottil.
52' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) trips an opposition player and Juan Luca Sacchi signals a foul.
46' It's time for a substitution. Konan Ndri (Lecce) comes on in place of Lameck Banda.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Juan Luca Sacchi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Half-chance! Manu Kone (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wladimiro Falcone makes a great save.
40' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
37' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
35' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
32' Lameck Banda (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
30' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Juan Luca Sacchi shows the yellow card to Youssef Maleh (Lecce) for a heavy challenge.
26' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
23' Poor challenge! Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is penalised for tripping and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle.
21' The ball is cleared after Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' Flag goes up against Francesco Camarda (Lecce) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' 0 - 1 Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) gets on the scoresheet with a cool finish after firing the ball into the goal off the left post!
12' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
10' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' A lofted cross from Lameck Banda (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
5' The foul by Lameck Banda (Lecce) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Juan Luca Sacchi.
4' A dangerous looking corner kick from Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is cleared to safety by the defence.
3' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
3' The referee blows his whistle as Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) was too aggressive in his challenge.
2' Manu Kone (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
